text.p: Monaco of France beat Internazionale of Italy 1-0 (halftime 0-0) in the second leg of their UEFA Cup semifinal on Tuesday.
Inter qualify for final 3-2 on aggregate

Monaco - 1-Fabien Barthez; 2-Patrick Blondeau, 5-Franck Dumas, 4-Martin Djetou, 19-Lilian Martin (11-Marco Grassi 87); 6-Emmanuel Petit, 15-Sylvain Legwinski, 7-John Collins (28-Thierry Henry 62), 10-Enzo Scifo; 24-Victor Ikpeba, 9-Sonny Anderson.

Internazionale - 1-Gianluca Pagliuca; 20-Jocelyn Angloma, 19-Massimo Paganin, 7-Savatore Fresi, 2-Giuseppe Bergomi; 4-Javier Zanetti, 8-Paul Ince, 21-Ciriaco Sforza, 14-Aron Winter (27-Marco Branca 72); 6-Youri Djorkaeff, 23-Maurizio Ganz (5-Fabio Galante 88).
